title: Data Center Flex Area Security Manager, Compliance, Strategy, and Risk Management (2nd Shift)
description:
This role is not eligible for U.S. immigration sponsorship.  
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Mesa, AZ, USA; Claude, TX, USA; Henderson, NV, USA**.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 7 years of experience in Physical Security, Risk Management, and Physical Security Policy.
* Experience managing a geographically dispersed extended workforce.
* Must be available to travel up to 75% to support business priorities as operationally required.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree.
* 4 years of experience managing incidents and crises.
* Advanced experience with physical security, investigations, compliance or risk management.
* Familiarity with Google applications.

**About the job**
-----------------

As a Data Center Security Manager, you deliver full pieces of a project and make significant contributions with minimal guidance. You use your knowledge of security technology, data analysis, and data visualization to plan efforts of a team responsible for small to medium sized initiatives by delivering value-added perspectives and influencing project direction. You contribute to cross-team collaborations, identify and recommend multiple creative ways to solve defined problems. You also demonstrate the behaviors expected of all Googlers as captured in Google's cultural pillars, and you engage in community contributions to improve and sustain our culture and operations, making Google a better place to work.

As a Data Center Flex Area Security Manager, you will drive the outcomes of key data center infrastructure through technical contributions. You will use your deep knowledge of data center security designs, operations, and local laws to develop and lead programs that align with regional or global strategy in order to gain site efficiency. title: Data Center Operations Engineer
description:
AMAX is an IT infrastructure and engineering company that designs, manufactures, and deploys advanced computing solutions for enterprise and OEM customers. Its work spans GPU-accelerated, high-performance, and AI-focused systems, helping customers solve complex technical challenges with reliable, scalable platforms.

We are looking for a skilled Linux Systems Administrator to support, maintain, and scale our enterprise infrastructure and High-Performance Computing (HPC) clusters. In this role, you will help manage hundreds of Linux servers across multi-vendor data center hardware. You will focus on maintaining high system reliability, automating routine administration tasks, and resolving complex hardware and OS-level issues in a collaborative R&D environment.

### **Responsibilities**

* Data Center & Hardware Support: Execute physical server racking, structured cabling, and hardware upgrades (GPUs, NICs, memory, and drives).
* Linux Server Administration: Administer, monitor, and maintain Linux servers to ensure 99%+ uptime across R&D and production workloads.
* Automation & Patching: Write and maintain Ansible playbooks to automate server provisioning, routine OS patching, and configuration management.
* Troubleshooting & Root-Cause Analysis: Conduct system log analysis, OS debugging, and hardware diagnostics to resolve incidents quickly and minimize downtime.
* Storage & Core System Management: Configure local storage using LVM, partitioning, and filesystem management. Manage system services and handle software packages.
* Networking & Host Security: Configure host-level networking including VLANs, network bridges, static/dynamic IP addressing, and high-speed interconnects (InfiniBand). Maintain system security policies.

* Experience: 6–8 years of hands-on experience in Linux systems administration and data center operations.
